User-confirmed: administrators only across UI/tool/Remote. Protect mandatory governance plugins. Q1 resolved 2026-09-18: all four upstream install sources (registry, absolute path, git, tarball) are allowed for administrators; dependency build scripts follow the upstream approval model (Web allow-and-retry and tool-side approvedBuilds), persisted per package name and attributed to the approving administrator.

User-confirmed: separate user/project authorization, disabled by default. System account permissions do not substitute for tenant policy. Q2 resolved 2026-09-18: dual gate — an administrator must enable both the user and the project; terminals are private to their creator, invisible to other project members; administrators may list and close but never take over input; read-only members have no terminal access at all.

Q3 resolved 2026-09-18: ship the sidebar Browser matching upstream — iframe carrier, loopback allowed, per-tab temporary unsandbox toggle with warning, DSH origin rejected; address bar must note that loopback resolves on the visitor’s machine, never as a host-URL promise. Q4 resolved 2026-09-18: declared platforms are macOS arm64 (native engine) and Linux (WASM); Windows is not claimed; a Linux WASM acceptance environment is required or Linux stays unverified. File authorization, conversion cache isolation, resource limits and native/WASM artifact checks required. Deliverables are owned by the deliverables-workspace-changes decision.
